heros.style_de_jeu: Abrams has the bulk and sustain to lead from the front, often running into the middle of his foes and watching them scatter. If his enemies waste their fire on him, his backline teammates can lay out damage with impunity.

competences.resume: Drain health from nearby enemies
competences.description: Drain health from nearby enemies, dealing spirit damage over time and healing for a portion of the damage dealt.
ameliorations: +2m Radius and +18.0 DPS with improved Spirit scaling

competences.resume: Charge into the fray, dragging enemies along
competences.description: Charge forward, pulling enemies you hit. Pushing a hero into a wall applies stun. · If you collide with a hero you move faster during your charge.
ameliorations: -18s Cooldown · On Hero Collide: +1.5 Weapon Damage for 6s

competences.resume: Regenerate some of the damage you receive
competences.description: Gain bonus defensive attributes. Taking damage grants temporary regeneration for a portion of the damage taken.

competences.resume: Smash into enemies from above, stunning them
competences.description: Leap high into the air before crashing into the ground, dealing spirit damage and applying stun.
ameliorations: On cast, become Unstoppable for 5s and +6m Impact Radius

competences.description: Draw a sigil sphere in front of you and then leap backwards as it explodes, damaging and slowing enemies caught in it.
ameliorations: Gain +25% Fire Rate and +25% Bullet Speed for 8s
On Player Hit: +1 stamina restored and resets Air Jump/Dash limit

competences.description: Prepare to deflect the next incoming attack. On a successful deflection, briefly become invulnerable and target an enemy hero to dash towards them, stunning them and reducing their Melee Resist. · · Press Ability 2 to select a target. · Does not trigger against trooper or neutral damage.
ameliorations: Gain 75% Bullet, Spirit & Melee Lifesteal against the Riposte target for 13s

competences.description: Perform a series of lunges in any direction, delivering piercing stabs ahead of you. Hold your ability key to time your attacks, dealing more damage the longer it's held. Releasing your attack during the perfect window deals maximum damage. · · Press Ability 3 to re-cast.
ameliorations: -12s Cooldown. Gain +60% Bullet Resist during lunge
+65 Perfect Damage with improved Spirit scaling. · Increased lunge speed & distance.

competences.description: Charge up and perform a long range slash. Struck enemies cannot take action or heal and are stuck in slow motion. When this effect expires, they suffer devastating damage, dealing bonus damage against half-health enemies. · · While in slow motion, Apollo is invulnerable and enemies take reduced damage. · · Hold Ability 4 or to delay the cast.

heros.role: Hooks an enemy for a knockout combo
heros.style_de_jeu: Bebop can string together his abilities in many different ways. Disrupting enemy positions, saving an ally or dealing bursts of damage. When the situation doesn't require subtlety his giant laser still solves many problems.

competences.resume: Punch someone away from you
competences.description: Deal melee damage to nearby enemies and apply knockback. · · When they land, they deal spirit damage and apply reduced fire rate to other nearby enemies. · · Exploding Uppercut can be used on allies.
ameliorations: On Hero Hit: Gain fast spin-up time, 2x weapon range and +30% weapon damage for 9s
On Hero Hit: Set Grapple Arm cooldown to 0 and restores +18% of your missing health

competences.resume: Plant a bomb on an enemy
competences.description: Attach a bomb that explodes after a delay, dealing spirit damage to nearby enemies. · · If the bomb hits or kills a hero, you gain permanent bonus damage on Sticky Bomb. · · Stacks diminish by half after 60 hits and 7 kills
ameliorations: On Cast: +5m Move Speed and +25% Debuff Resistance for 6s

competences.resume: Pull in a target to you
competences.description: Launch out a mechanical hand that pulls the first character it hits, reeling them in. · · Grapple Arm can be used on allies.

competences.resume: Unleash a massive damaging beam
competences.description: Channel a powerful torrent of energy that deals spirit damage and applies slow.
ameliorations: Hyper Beam heals Bebop for 65% of its damage on Heroes. 20% on non-hero

competences.description: Slam your bat into the ground, pulling enemies down and dealing melee damage. · · The slam creates a shockwave that deals spirit damage and applies knockup.
ameliorations: -3.0s Charge Time · Now deals 50% Heavy Melee Damage

competences.description: Charge head-first into an enemy and send them into the air along with Billy. · · Cooldown reduced by 50% on impact.
Passive: Melee hits restore ammo and inflict wrecked on the victim for 7.0s.
ameliorations: +1 Bashdown Charge on use and +7% Wrecked Bullet Amp
+50 Melee Bonus Health and increases spirit scaling

competences.description: Chain nearby enemies to you. Chained enemies cannot use movement abilities and receive a heavy slow when they pull on the chain. · · After a delay, yank everyone towards Billy and deal spirit damage. · · The chain breaks if you lose line of sight for a short while.
ameliorations: +5m Range · +1.3s of Unstoppable Per Hero pulled in

heros.style_de_jeu: Calico uses the shadows to her advantage, weaving in and out of combat to hunt down her enemies one by one.

competences.resume: Throw out cluster bombs
competences.description: Throw a cluster of bombs that detonate after a delay, dealing spirit damage. · · Enemies hit by multiple bombs take 65% damage.
ameliorations: Per Bomb Touch : -6% Melee Resist for 6s

competences.resume: Dash forward and slash enemies
competences.description: Dash forward before slashing all enemies in a circle, dealing melee damage. · · If the ability hits at least one hero, heal a small amount of health.
ameliorations: +60 Damage & On Hero Hit: 50% Cooldown Refund

competences.resume: Take control of Ava
competences.description: Turn to shadows and possess Ava. You gain bonus move speed that increases over time, and become hidden on the minimap. · · Taking damage from an enemy hero resets your bonus move speed and puts Ava on a brief cooldown.
ameliorations: Gain Damage Amp over time, up to 18%. Lingers for 6s

competences.resume: Turn to Shadows, gaining movespeed and dealing delayed damage
competences.description: Instantly turn to shadows, becoming untargetable, gaining bonus move speed, and dealing spirit damage. · · After a delay, return from the shadows, dealing spirit damage again.
ameliorations: On Completion: Heal for 450 and refund all ability cooldowns

competences.description: Blast enemies in a cone in front of you with a flare of light. Blasted enemies take spirit damage when attacked by Celeste and provides her spirit lifesteal.
Surround yourself in a protective prism. If the barrier is destroyed, it silences nearby enemies and deals a portion of the barrier as damage.
ameliorations: +70 Barrier and Increased Barrier Spirit Scaling
+1.25 Silence Duration and -20s Cooldown. Allows Shining Wonder Bounce.

competences.description: Call down a beam of light from the sky. After a short duration, the beam will fully form, causing an explosion that deals spirit damage to all targets in the area. · · Celeste will receive a stacking buff that increases her spirit damage anytime this hits an enemy hero.

Launch a deadly orb of light that deals spirit damage and applies slow and reduces Dash Distance on impact. The orb then bounces to the enemies within range. If no target is found, the orb will linger for a short duration while continuing to look for targets. · · Prioritizes enemy heroes when picking targets.
Swipe at enemies in a cone ahead of you, dealing spirit damage. If the enemy is in close range, deal bonus melee damage.
ameliorations: Deals 55% Heavy Melee Damage · Silences enemies for 2s if close range

competences.description: Send out a mark that bleeds the first target it hits, dealing spirit damage over time. · · While the enemy is bleeding you can re-activate Stalker's Mark to instantly appear behind their back.

ameliorations: +3m/s Move Speed when around an isolated enemy hero
On isolated hero death: Heal 24% of your missing health and restores 2 Stamina

competences.description: Surround nearby enemy heroes in darkness, severely limiting their vision of other units. Affected enemies are briefly revealed to you and are considered isolated for the duration. · · You gain bonus sprint speed.

heros.style_de_jeu: Dynamo keeps himself and his allies healthy while waiting for his moment. Few things can warp a team fight more than a well-coordinated use of Singularity.

competences.resume: Release a ground pulse that knocks enemies into the air
competences.description: Release an energy pulse that travels along the ground, dealing spirit damage and applying knockup.
ameliorations: On Hit: -15% Bullet Resist and -24% Move Speed for 4s

competences.resume: Blink in and out of existence
competences.description: Briefly become untargetable while teleporting to the target location. Restores stamina upon use. · · : Bring nearby allies with you.
ameliorations: Reduces non-ult debuffs by 50% · Replenishes 1 Charge

competences.resume: Heal yourself and those around you
competences.description: While channeling, restore health over time to you and any allies nearby. · You can dash and melee without breaking the channel.
ameliorations: Aura provides +4m Move Speed during channel
Full move and ability use and additionally heals +2.5% of Max Health per second

competences.resume: Pull in and stun the enemy team
competences.description: Create a singularity in your hands, dealing spirit damage over time, applying stun, and pulling in nearby enemies.

Passive: Collect death when anything dies nearby and store it in your Jar of Dead. · · Active: Throw a jar to summon Deadheads that repeatedly deal spirit damage to enemies. · · Deadheads follow you instead if there's no nearby enemies, and prioritize the target of your weapon.
ameliorations: Collecting death heals 5 health per pickup

competences.description: Unearth a line of grasping hands, summoning a Ghoul and leaving behind a rift. Enemies who pass through take spirit damage and receive immobilize. · · Alt-Cast rotates the orientation of the wall.
Your weapon steals weapon damage and spirit resist over time, up to a maximum amount per target.
ameliorations: +1 Max Steal Targets · All Summons now apply Essence Theft
On Death: Deal +5% Current Health as Damage

heros.style_de_jeu: A cunning predator, Grey Talon uses a combination of deadly accuracy, traps, and clever positioning to bring down the toughest of opponents.

competences.resume: Charge up a long range shot
competences.description: Charge up a powerful shot that pierces through enemies. Hold Ability 1 or to hold the shot.
ameliorations: Improved damage scaling and -3s Charge Delay

competences.resume: Jump high up in the air and unleash multishots
competences.description: Launches you high in the air, allowing you to glide slowly. While airborne, you gain Weapon Damage and multishot on your weapon. · for reduced jump height. · Press Jump / mantle to cancel the glide.
ameliorations: While airborne, +3 Weapon Damage and weapon damage applies 24% movement slow for 1.5s
While airborne, +30% Bullet Lifesteal, +30% Spirit Lifesteal and +30% Bullet Evasion

competences.resume: Place a trap that restricts enemy movement
competences.description: Throw out a trap that begins to arm itself. Once armed, the trap will trigger when an enemy enters its radius, applying Curse and Movement Slow that interrupts, Silences, Disarms, and prevents item usage. · Hit the trap with a Charged Shot to detonate early with increased radius.

competences.resume: Fly your owl to damage enemies from afar
competences.description: After 1.5s cast time, launch a spirit owl that you control and which explodes on impact, damaging and stunning enemies. Hold [W] to accelerate the owl. · Press Jump / mantle to release control. Gain permanent Spirit Power for each enemy hero killed with Guided Owl.
ameliorations: After hit, kills enemies that are below 22% Health

heros.style_de_jeu: When Haze fixates on a target she can hold her own in a firefight. She prefers to create one sided exchanges, avoiding damage then picking off unsuspecting targets up close.

competences.resume: Put an enemy to sleep
competences.description: Throw a dagger that damages and sleeps the target. Sleeping targets wake up shortly after being damaged. Throwing a Dagger does not break your invisibility. Sleep Dagger does not interrupt enemies' channeling abilities.
ameliorations: -10.0% Bullet Resist Reduction for 6.0s on wake-up
-17.0s Cooldown · -40% Move and Dash Speed for 3s on wake-up

competences.resume: Fade out of sight
competences.description: Fade out of sight, becoming invisible and gaining sprint speed. Attacking removes invisibility, but using items does not. Close enemies can see through your invisibility.
ameliorations: Dispels non-ult debuffs · Grants +50% Bullet Lifesteal for 5s

competences.resume: Deal increasing bullet damage to a target
competences.description: Shooting a target increases your bullet damage on that target. Gain one stack per bullet hit, three if the hit is a headshot.
ameliorations: 40.0 Spirit damage and 12% slow for 2s to target every 20 stacks
+0.11/ per Stack · Scales with Weapon Damage

competences.resume: Unleash a flurry of bullets around you
competences.description: Enter a flurry, firing your weapon at nearby enemies with perfect accuracy and added Bullet Damage.

heros.style_de_jeu: Holliday depends on her skills as a crack shot, shooting things she's bounced into the air. With good aim she can lay out heavy damage. Her movement skills let her isolate her enemies or beat a hasty retreat.

competences.resume: Throw a barrel that explodes when shot
competences.description: Throw a barrel that explodes after a delay, dealing spirit damage, setting enemies on fire and applying knockup. · · The barrel can be detonated early by being shot, melee'd, or detonated by another barrel. · · The burn stacks, so overlapping barrels burn for their combined damage. · Can be Alt-Cast to place the barrel in front of Holliday.
ameliorations: +40 Impact Damage · +13.3333 Burn Damage per Second · -5s Charge Time · Improved Spirit Scaling

competences.resume: Send yourself and others flying
competences.description: Drop a bounce pad in the world that launches any hero. · · You explode on landing, dealing Damage to any nearby enemies. · · The explosion can only occur once per person per Bounce Pad.
ameliorations: You and allies gain a +4m/s move speed bonus for 4s on landing

competences.resume: Deal bonus damage with headshots
competences.description: Headshots deal bonus Damage and applies a Fading Move Speed penalty. This effect can only occur when off cooldown. · · Cooldown is reduced by 50% on NPC hits. · Crackshot ignores range damage fall-off and does not apply to objectives.
ameliorations: -6s Cooldown on Hero Headshots. -3s on NPC Headshots

competences.resume: Grab an enemy and drag them behind you
competences.description: Throw out your lasso, dealing spirit damage, pulling, and applying stun. · Using a Bounce Pad extends the duration of Spirit Lasso.

heros.role: Lights up enemies and watches them burn
heros.style_de_jeu: Infernus has many ways to deal damage over time, burning foes before swooping in for the kill. Due to Infernus' blazing speed, his enemies won't be able to escape the flames.

competences.resume: Spew napalm that amplifies your damage
competences.description: Spew an incendiary mixture, dealing spirit damage, applying slow, and coating targets in napalm.
ameliorations: Napalm Effect: +17% Damage Taken and -33% Healing

competences.resume: Blaze forward, leaving a flame trail in your wake
competences.description: Dash forward, gaining slow resistance while leaving a flaming trail that deals spirit damage over time. · · Hold [W] while active to dash farther.
ameliorations: Enable 2 Ability Charges with 14s Recharge time

competences.resume: Shoot enemies to set them on fire
competences.description: Weapon hits build up a burning effect, dealing spirit damage over time. · · Abilities refresh to the base burn duration and weapon hits extend it.

competences.resume: Stun all nearby enemies after a short delay
competences.description: Become a living bomb, dealing spirit damage and applying stun to all nearby enemies after a delay. · · Once cast, Concussive Combustion cannot be interrupted.

heros.role: Sets up a power duo with a lucky ally
heros.style_de_jeu: Ivy has disruptive combat tricks that slow and stun enemies. She's most effective when linking up with an ally, empowering her and her ally's guns as well as sharing heals.

competences.resume: Damage and slow enemies in the area
competences.description: Summon a patch of choking thorns that damages and slows enemies in its radius.
ameliorations: +2m Radius and increased DPS Spirit scaling
Enemies caught in thorns for 2.0s are Immobilized for +1.6s

competences.resume: Empower yourself and a nearby ally
competences.description: Connect with a nearby ally to gain bonuses, replicated healing, and ignore the move speed penalty while shooting. · · Receive 50% of Bonuses with no connection · Connection requires line of sight.

competences.resume: Turn into impervious stone and stun enemies nearby
competences.description: Turn yourself into impervious stone and smash into the ground, stunning and damaging enemies nearby. Heals you for a percentage of your max health.
ameliorations: +0.75s Stun Duration and increased Damage spirit scaling

competences.resume: Death from Above! Fly and drop an ally on enemies
competences.description: Grab an ally and take flight with them. Drop your ally to cause an explosion, dealing spirit damage. You and your ally gain increased Outgoing Damage when flying ends. · · Cooldown reduced by 30% when used on allies. · Taking damage briefly disables using the ability. · While lifted, your ally cannot attack and deals -20% damage.
ameliorations: On Fly End : 300 Barrier to Ivy and ally that scales with Spirit
Silence for 3s on enemies hit. · Increases damage and barrier scaling.

heros.style_de_jeu: Timely heals and splitting a teamfight properly is the difference between an easy victory or a ruinous defeat. Gliding around slowing enemies gives Kelvin's team the maneuvering advantage to make this happen.

competences.resume: Damage and slow enemies
competences.description: Throw a grenade that explodes in a cloud of freezing ice that heals allies and applies spirit damage and move speed reduction to enemies.
ameliorations: -10 Cooldown and debuff now freezes Stamina Regen
+2m Radius. Damage and Heal Spirit Scaling increased.

competences.resume: Speed around on a floating path of ice
competences.description: Kelvin creates a floating trail of ice and snow that gives movement bonuses to him and his allies. Kelvin gains 60% slow resistance for the duration. Enemies can also walk on the floating trail. · Press Dash / Crouch / slide to travel up or down while in Ice Path.
ameliorations: +2m Move Speed and +35% Bullet Resist for Kelvin while on Ice Path
+35% Spirit and +20 Spirit for Kelvin while on Ice Path

competences.resume: Apply an escalating slow
competences.description: Shoot freezing cold energy out in front of you, damaging targets and progressively reducing their movement and fire rate the longer you sustain the beam on them. You have reduced move speed while using Arctic Beam. The beam may also claim Souls.
ameliorations: -20.0% to Fire Rate and Move Speed
-13s Cooldown and Fires 2 additional Arctic Beams within 10m of the last target hit.

competences.resume: Create an impenetrable healing dome
competences.description: Target yourself or a Hero to freeze the air and create an impenetrable dome around them. While in the dome, allies gain rapid regeneration and enemies are slowed. · · Objectives become Invulnerable and Frozen under Frozen Shelter
ameliorations: Purges non-ult debuffs for you and your allies. · +65 Health Regen and increased Spirit Scaling

heros.role: Sacrifices health then drains it back
heros.style_de_jeu: Expending health to achieve devastating effects is the source of Lady Geist's power. When running low, she can drain the life out of her rivals.

competences.resume: Sacrifice some health to launch a damaging bomb
competences.description: Sacrifice some of your health to launch a bomb that deals damage after a brief arm time. · Self damage type is Spirit and can be mitigated.
ameliorations: Bombs leave a toxic mess on the ground, dealing 30.0% of the original damage per second, for 6s.

competences.resume: Steal health from an enemy over time
competences.description: Create a tether that drains enemy health over time and heals you. Target must be in line of sight and within max range to drain. You can shoot and use other abilities during the drain, but your move speed is reduced. · to give health to friendly Heroes.
ameliorations: Enables and Grants +2 Charges. Increases spirit scaling.

competences.resume: Stack damage amplification on an enemy
competences.description: Sacrifice some of your health to launch blood shards that apply a stack of Malice. Each stack slows the victim and increases the damage they take from you. The slow effect decreases over time.

competences.resume: Swap your current health with an enemy hero's
competences.description: Swaps health levels with an enemy target. There is a minimum health percentage that enemies can be brought down to and a minimum amount of health received based on victims current health.
ameliorations: On cast, +60 Spirit Power, +40% Fire Rate and +50% Spirit Resistance for 8s.

heros.role: Dives down to stomp his foes
heros.style_de_jeu: Lash gives his enemies little room to breathe, either by flying in from long distances to initiate combat with unsuspecting enemies, or pursuing said enemies when they try to run.

competences.resume: Slam down to the ground, damaging enemies
competences.description: Stomp the ground beneath you, damaging enemies in front of you. If you perform Ground Strike while airborne, you quickly dive towards the ground. Damage grows slower after 25m.
ameliorations: Struck enemies are knocked up and slowed by 40% for 3s
Damage Per Meter +120% and improved scaling

competences.resume: Use your whip to pull yourself to an enemy
competences.description: Pull yourself through the air toward a target. Using Grapple also resets your limit of air jumps and dashes.
ameliorations: +20m Cast Range and gain +7.0 Weapon Damage for 6s
+1 Charges · OnCast : +1 Stamina and +60% Air Control

competences.resume: Heals from targets ahead of you
competences.description: Strike enemies in front of you with your whip, healing for a portion of the damage dealt.

competences.resume: Lift enemies and smash them into the ground
competences.description: Focus on enemies to connect whips to them. After channeling, connected enemies are lifted and stunned then slammed into the ground. Your victims and any enemies in the landing zone will be damaged and slowed. · Press to throw connected enemies early. Enemies that are not in line of sight or go out of range during the latch time will not be grabbed.
ameliorations: Stun enemies in Radius for 1.2s · +6m Cast Range

heros.role: Controls the battle with combat turrets
heros.style_de_jeu: Precise placement is everything for McGinnis, whether she's creating a killzone or splitting the enemy team. She can help keep her team running making them hard to dislodge when entrenched.

competences.resume: Deploy an automated turret
competences.description: Deploy a turret that shoots enemies, dealing spirit damage over time. The turret expires after a limited lifetime. · Turrets deal reduced damage to troopers and objectives.
ameliorations: +25% Turret Fire Rate and +12s Turret Lifetime

competences.resume: Deploy a healing spirit
competences.description: Deploy a spirit that provides healing to nearby allies.
ameliorations: +2.0% Max HP Regen · +3m Heal Radius · +40% Spirit Resist

competences.resume: Conjure a wall to block your foes
competences.description: Cast a wall that applies slow on enemies it passes through. Erupt the wall to divide the terrain in half and damage nearby enemies. · After casting, press or Ability 3 to erupt the wall early. · · Can be Destroyed with Melee Attacks
ameliorations: Amplifies McGinnis's damage by +20% on hit enemies for 7s
Deploy 2 Mini Turrets near the wall for 8s · +24% Slow

competences.resume: Bombard an area with rockets
competences.description: Unleashes a volley of rockets that home in on a targeted location. · · McGinnis is slowed and is still able to use stamina.
ameliorations: Applies 24% movement and dash slow for 1s
+2m Radius and +15.0 Damage per Rocket with increased spirit scaling
+7.0% Missing health damage and increased Heal per Kill Spirit scaling

competences.description: Briefly disperse, becoming untargetable and flying to a target location. · · Can be recast within a brief window.
ameliorations: On Cast: Gain +25% Fire Rate for 8s and add 8 bullets

competences.description: Your bullets apply additional spirit damage. Dealing damage with your abilities builds up to a vicious bite, dealing a burst of bonus spirit damage. · · Love Bites has a unique cooldown per target.
ameliorations: +3.0 Spirit Damage per Bullet & · +45.0 Bonus Damage
-5 Cooldown · On Proc: +25% Fire Rate for 5s

competences.description: Active: Unleash a cloud of bats that seek out targets, each dealing spirit damage and applying Silence. · · Passive: Triggering Love Bites against heroes permanently increases the number of bats released.
ameliorations: On Hit: Deal +0.5% Current Health as Damage

heros.role: Times his shots and catches fleeing targets
heros.style_de_jeu: Mirage can envelop himself in a violent tornado to catch up to enemies and lift them up. His scarabs help him sustain against multiple enemies, and he's always ready to help an ally or punish an enemy anywhere.

competences.resume: Send out scarabs that steal life from enemies
competences.description: Infest an enemy with fire scarabs, stealing life from them and causing them to deal reduced damage.

competences.resume: Transform yourself into a whirlwind that lifts enemies
competences.description: Transform yourself into a whirlwind that travels forward, damaging enemies, slowing their move speed and lifting them up in the air. After emerging from the tornado you gain bullet evasion.

competences.resume: Apply marks of escalating damage
competences.description: Active: Consume all Djinn Marks to deal their damage now.
ameliorations: On Proc: Apply a fading 48% Slow for 0.8s
-0.75s Cooldown · +1 Max Marks · Stun Victim for 0.5s on Max Marks

competences.resume: Teleport to an ally or enemy hero
competences.description: Target a location on the minimap. After a brief wait, teleport to that location. Taking damage during the wait period causes the teleport to be interrupted.
ameliorations: +3m Move Speed and +20% Fire Rate for 12s

heros.style_de_jeu: By burrowing through the ground, Mo and Krill can get the drop on almost anyone; and once they get in close the results can be devastating.

competences.resume: Damage enemies nearby, healing from each hit
competences.description: Deal damage to nearby enemies and heal yourself based on the damage done. Heal is stronger against enemy heroes.
ameliorations: Adds a debuff to enemies that lets Mo & Krill deal +15% Damage to them. Stacks and lasts 16s.

competences.resume: Travel underground, emerging with spin damage
competences.description: Burrow underground, moving faster, and gaining spirit and bullet armor. Damage from enemy heroes will reduce the speed bonus. · · When you jump out, deal spirit damage, slow, and knockup.

competences.resume: Disarm enemies in front of you
competences.description: Spray sand that disarms enemies in front of you and deals damage.
ameliorations: Slow targets by -24% and reduces dash distances by -26%

competences.resume: Hold the enemy hero in place and pummel them
competences.description: Hold the target in place, stunning them and dealing damage during the channel. If they die during, or within 3 seconds of Combo ending, you permanently gain max health.
ameliorations: +0.7s Duration and +40.0 Damage Per Second and increased scaling

competences.description: Conjure a dragon that appears at the target location before flying forward, dealing spirit damage and leaving a burning path in its trail.
Grant an ally a barrier. While the barrier holds, they gain bonus weapon damage.
ameliorations: Affects up to 2 additional allies. · Increases barrier scaling.

competences.description: Target an area with latent magic, applying slow. · · The magic detonates after a delay, dealing spirit damage and applying immobilize.
ameliorations: +2m Radius · On Hit: Reduce Spirit Resist by -18% for 6s

competences.description: Release a wave of spectral knights and steeds that charge across the entire city, healing allies and dealing spirit damage to enemies. · · The strength of the heal and spirit damage is amplified as the knights travel further.

heros.style_de_jeu: Manipulating time lets Paradox outpace an enemy in one on one combat. She thrives by subjecting her enemies to timely swaps into a waiting pulse grenade, her wall, or into the middle of her teammates.

competences.resume: Throw a grenade that pulses, dealing damage and time slowing
competences.description: Throw a grenade that begins pulsing when it lands. Each pulse expands the radius and applies spirit damage, time slow, and stacking increased damage for Paradox against the victim.
ameliorations: +20.0 Pulse Damage and increased Spirit scaling

competences.resume: Create a wall that greatly slows projectiles
competences.description: Create a time warping wall that stops time for all enemy projectiles and bullets that touch it and increases the speed and damage of friendly bullets. · · Enemies that touch the wall will be briefly slowed.

competences.resume: Charge up your weapon to deal high damage and timestop
competences.description: Charge up a powerful shot of time energy, dealing spirit damage and applying a Time-Stop to enemies hit. The damage dealt increases with weapon damage. Move speed is increased while charging. · · While in the air and charging, to timeslow your movement.
ameliorations: +2s Charge Hold Duration and +55% Damage Scaling

competences.resume: Swap positions with an enemy hero.
competences.description: Fire a projectile that swaps your position with the target enemy hero.
ameliorations: 200 Barrier for 8s. Barrier scales with Spirit
Swaps all enemies within 7m of hit target and +10% Max Health Damage

heros.style_de_jeu: With a powerful shotgun and a thin frame, Pocket relies on their ability to briefly escape into a mystic suitcase and teleport via a flying cloak in order to survive close encounters.

competences.resume: Air glide while firing multiple projectiles
competences.description: Channel to start launching projectiles that deal spirit damage and apply slow around their impact point. Projectiles that hit a hero grant Pocket increased damage that stacks. · Casting while airborne will cause Pocket to float. · · Casting AirDash or Flying Cloak will not cancel Barrage.

competences.resume: Launch a damaging cloak that you can teleport to
competences.description: Launch a sentient cloak that travels forward and damages enemies. You can press Ability 2 to teleport to its location.

competences.resume: Briefly escape into your suitcase, then deal damage
competences.description: Escape into your suitcase. When the duration ends, deal spirit damage to nearby enemies. Duration can be ended early by performing any action.
ameliorations: +1.5s Duration · +4m Radius · -32% Move Speed and Fire Rate for 4.0s

competences.resume: Apply damage over time to enemies nearby
competences.description: Applies damage over time to enemies nearby. · · Affliction's damage is non-lethal and does not apply item procs.
ameliorations: Prevents all healing · +13.0 DPS with increased Spirit scaling

competences.description: Throw your trusty pillow inflicting spirit damage and heavy knockback. · · Landing hits reduces the cooldown of your other abilities.

Jump to an ally and nap alongside them. Both you and the ally receive a burst heal based on missing health followed by lingering regeneration. · · Hop between allies with Ability 2 to apply the heal, once per ally. · · You are knocked off if stunned by an ultimate ability. · You can use items and all self-casts target your ally instead.
ameliorations: 35% Bonus Item Range, Duration, and Barrier Effectiveness while napping
+15% Spirit Power and +35 Spirit Power while napping and for 10s after napping · Improved Spirit Scaling

competences.description: Signal a Helper to lend a hand. They can collect boxes, do Sinner's Sacrifices, or be sent to support allies and troopers. · · Follow a hero: Provides a short burst of spirit resist and fading move speed. · · Follow a trooper: Provides healing, damage, resists, and allows tagging along. When no hero is around, souls from trooper kills are split amongst the team. · · Can be cast during Tag Along. Helpers will take a nap for 15.1s after following someone.

Cast your gaze forward, piercing walls and floors. Enemies in the gaze are slowed, have reduced dash distance, and cannot use movement abilities. · · When the channel ends they fall asleep before waking up to a splitting headache that deals heavy spirit damage.
ameliorations: -1 Stamina On Wake and no Stamina Regen while sleeping
-55s cooldown · Reduced damage and unstoppable while channeling

heros.style_de_jeu: Seven thrives in a skirmish waiting for the time to strike. Then he rolls into the fight like a storm and batters his enemies with a cascade of lightning.

competences.resume: Launch a damaging ball of lightning
competences.description: Shoot a ball of lightning that travels in a straight line. Does damage to all targets in its radius. Slows down when damaging enemies and stops if it hits the world.
ameliorations: -28% move speed on hit targets and +1s Lifetime

competences.resume: Apply a delayed area stun to an enemy hero
competences.description: Apply a charge to a target enemy hero. After a short duration, the static charge stuns and damages enemies within the radius.

competences.resume: Create electric arcs with your shots
competences.description: Power up your weapon with a shock effect, making your bullets proc shock damage on your target. This shock damage bounces to enemies near your target. Occurs once per burst shot.
ameliorations: +3m Move Speed · +8 Damage and increased scaling

competences.resume: Fry all enemies in a large area
competences.description: Channel an expanding storm cloud around you that damages all enemies within its radius. Enemies do not take damage when they are out of line-of-sight.
ameliorations: +55% Bullet Resist while channeling Storm Cloud
+7s Channel Time · +10m Final Radius · +5m Initial Radius

heros.role: Bleeds out foes, then goes in for a kill
heros.style_de_jeu: Shiv has zero interest in playing fair, which is why he relies on hit and run tactics to weaken enemies before he dives in for the kill.

competences.resume: Apply stacking bleed to the target
competences.description: Throw a knife that bleeds an enemy. Each additional hit adds a stack and refreshes the bleed duration, causing the bleed to increase per stack.
ameliorations: +12.0 Bleed DPS with increased Spirit scaling

competences.resume: Dash ahead, damaging all enemies along the path
competences.description: Perform a dash forward, damaging enemies along the path. Hit Enemies have their spirit resist reduced. This debuff can stack.
ameliorations: +50 Impact Damage · -2s Cooldown per Hero hit.

competences.resume: Defer a portion of damage taken
competences.description: Take only a portion of incoming damage immediately and defer the rest to be taken over time. Activate to clear a portion of the deferred damage.

competences.resume: Travel to a low health hero and instantly kill it
ameliorations: +6 m Range · +2 m/s in Full Rage.

competences.description: Instantly reload your gun. You gain bonus fire rate and deal bonus weapon damage based on the target's health for a limited number of shots, but suffer from reduced accuracy. · · Deals bonus Weapon Damage against troopers and neutrals.
ameliorations: If you hit all shots, deal +7% current health as damage
+80 Bonus Damage and kicked enemies deal -35% Damage for 5s

competences.description: Throw a bola, dealing spirit damage, applying slow and preventing movement abilities or stamina.
ameliorations: +0.75s Debuff Duration. · Bola ricochets to 2 additional targets

competences.description: Passive: Dealing damage generates bloodlust, increased at low health. At max bloodlust, you automatically cast Lycan Curse. · · Active: Instantly transform, gaining increased max health, and stacking fire rate on enemy heroes, and replacing your abilities and weapon with their ferocious versions.
ameliorations: +4 m/s Move Speed and 200 Bonus Health
On Hero Kill: Refresh abilities and duration

heros.style_de_jeu: With the help of their unwilling assistant, The Magnificent Sinclair can confuse enemies with curving hexes and rapid bolts.

competences.resume: Launch a guided bolt of magic
competences.description: Fire a bolt of magic that deals Damage, increasing as it travels. If you have an Assistant, they also cast Vexing Bolt at reduced damage. · · Press Ability 1 to redirect the bolt towards your crosshairs.

competences.resume: Summon your faithful assistant
competences.description: Summon an Assistant at the targeted location. The Assistant attacks whenever you fire your weapon, dealing Damage. · · While the Assistant is out, you can press Ability 2 to swap positions with your Assistant. · · Casting Spectral Assistant also reloads your weapon.

Hex a target area and transform all enemies into a Rabbit for a limited duration. · · Rabbits are small and move faster, but take increased Damage and are unable to perform most actions. · Hex does not interrupt abilities.

competences.resume: Copy an enemy's Ultimate for a limited time
competences.description: Copy the Ultimate of an enemy hero for a limited time. Reactivating the ability will use the Copied Ultimate instead. · · Copies will inherit this ability's upgrade points. · Audience Participation will also copy the cooldown.

Throw out a call bell that deals spirit damage on impact. After a short delay it explodes, dealing additional spirit damage and causing affected enemies to suffer reduced weapon accuracy and movement slow. · · Can be shot to detonate early.

Place two connected doors in the world. Players and most projectiles entering one door will exit out through the other. The doors will close at the end of the duration. · · The two doors must be placed within the doorway distance of each other.
ameliorations: Grants a Barrier first time traveling through doors
+30m Cast Range. +40m Doorway Distance · and scales with Spirit Power.

competences.description: Send out a Luggage Cart that deals spirit damage and pulls enemy heroes along its path. · · Can be alt cast with to target friendly heroes instead.
ameliorations: +25m Cast Range · +75 Damage on wall impact
-15s Cooldown and 1.25s stun on wall impact

competences.description: Send the target's physical body to be a guest at the Baroness Hotel. The guest is to promptly make their way to the exit elevator, where they'll be sent back to their original position. · · A stay at the Baroness Hotel is paid for in spirit damage. Failure to check-out on time costs additional spirit damage.
ameliorations: +150 Damage · +1.5s Stun on Failure to Check Out
Unstoppable while the Baroness is occupied. · 15s Cooldown on Failure to Check Out.

competences.description: Fire a grenade that bounces before exploding, dealing weapon damage and setting enemies on fire. · · Burning targets deal pure damage to enemies in the area and suffer from reduced healing.
Fire a blast with your shotgun, dealing weapon damage and pushing enemies back. Enemies near a wall receive stun and take bonus weapon damage.
ameliorations: On Wall Stun: Your next heavy melee is blessed

competences.description: Kick a trap that arms after a brief delay. · · The trap springs on the first enemy it touches, dealing spirit damage, applying immobilize, and revealing enemies for a duration afterwards.
ameliorations: +1 Charge · Deal +30% damage against revealed targets

competences.description: Load your crossbow with 3 stakes, dealing massively increased weapon damage. · · The final stake is blessed, dealing bonus pure damage and executing low-health enemies.
ameliorations: While Active: Gain 1.2 m/s Move Speed

competences.description: Taking any damage passively charges up your Pain Battery. · · Once full, activating the ability fires multiple shocking bolts, dealing spirit damage once per target.
ameliorations: On Hero Hit: Heal for 15% of your missing health and increased Spirit scaling

competences.description: Deal spirit damage to yourself. Then, gain bonus regeneration and bonus move speed, decaying over time.
ameliorations: +1 Charge · +50% Debuff Resistance · Increases spirit scaling

competences.description: Unleash pain, dealing spirit damage over time to both enemies and yourself. · · The damage continues to increase the longer the ability is channeled, up to a maximum amount.
ameliorations: Enemies receive 20% Move and Dash Slow

competences.description: Release a wave after taking lethal damage, applying a diminishing slow. · · After a brief channel you reanimate, dealing spirit damage and applying stun to nearby enemies.
ameliorations: While On Cooldown: Gain +15% Fire Rate and 6.0 Spirit Damage per Bullet

heros.style_de_jeu: Vindicta has the mobility to engage at her leisure, picking at her prey and bleeding them out slowly. Injured enemies at any distance should fear being picked off when she is on the map.

competences.resume: Tether your enemies to the ground
competences.description: Throw a stake that tethers enemies to the location where the stake lands. Enemy movement is restricted to the length of the tether.

competences.resume: Take flight and empower your weapon
competences.description: Leap into the air and fly. While in flight your weapon deals bonus spirit damage and your items have increased range.
ameliorations: Hero Kills Refresh Duration. · +10.0 Spirit Damage with increased Spirit scaling

competences.resume: Make a target bleed over time
competences.description: Your crow familiar deals impact damage, reduces their bullet resist and applies a bleed that deals damage based on the target's current health.

competences.resume: Snipe injured targets for massive damage
competences.description: Use your scoped rifle to fire a powerful shot over long distances. Deal only partial damage until fully charged after 1.0s of being scoped. Does bonus damage to enemies with less than 50% health remaining. Landing a killing blow on a player with Assassinate grants you bonus weapon damage.

heros.style_de_jeu: Viscous vexes his opponents through clever evasion and strategic uses of healing, enabling him to withstand the most brutal of enemy attacks.

competences.resume: Damage enemies and make a mess
competences.description: Throw a ball of goo that deals damage and leaves puddles of goo behind that apply movement slow to enemies in the radius.

competences.resume: The Cube is a safe place to be
competences.description: Encase the target in a cube of restorative goo that protects from damage, and increases health regen. Target is unable to take any new actions while cubed. Can be used on self. Press Jump / mantle to escape early.
ameliorations: Increases Move Speed and Stamina Recovery
Removes all non-ult Debuffs and -20.0s Cooldown

competences.resume: Punch enemies with a giant fist
competences.description: Materialize a fist in the world that punches everyone in the area, applying knockup. · · Punching an enemy deals melee damage and applies slow. Enemies can Parry this attack. · · You and your allies have increased Air Control.
ameliorations: -14.0s Cooldown and now deals Heavy Melee Damage

competences.resume: Roll around and cause chaos
competences.description: Morph into a large goo ball that deals damage and stuns enemies on impact. The ball grants large amounts of Bullet and Spirit resist, bounces off walls and can double jump.
ameliorations: +7s Duration, +0.3s Stun Duration, and +0.2 Spirit Scaling

heros.style_de_jeu: With a powerful weapon (and deadly venom to match), Vyper can slither into the back of teams and assassinate high-priority targets in a storm of bullets.

competences.resume: Throw a slowing dagger
competences.description: Throw a dagger, dealing spirit damage and applying slow. · · Every subsequent dagger against the same target stacks in spirit damage and slow.
ameliorations: On Hit: -8% Bullet Resist and -6% Bullet Resist per Stack
+2 Max Stacks · -2s Charge Delay · On Hit: Refund 55% Charge Cooldown

competences.resume: Inject your enemies with a deadly venom
competences.description: Inject a target with lethal venom. After a delay the venom triggers, dealing Spirit Damage. The damage is increased by the target's missing health. · · Lethal Venom will ignore Petrify's damage block.
ameliorations: Bullets also build up Lethal Venom

competences.resume: Increase the agility of your Slide
competences.description: You have increased Slide Distance, can Slide up hills, and can turn faster while Sliding.

competences.resume: Toss a petrifying bola
competences.description: Throw an explosive bola. On exploding, the bola Slows and Damages all enemies in the area. · · Direct hits deal Additional Damage and Petrify instead. Petrified units block all damage, but cannot take actions.
ameliorations: +1.0s Petrify Duration. Petrifies all enemies in the area.

heros.role: Weakens his enemies and chases them down
heros.style_de_jeu: Warden leads from the front, jumping into the fray and hindering his opponents' ability to fight effectively. But what Warden considers brave, others consider reckless, and if he's not careful he can easily find himself in over his head.

competences.resume: Damage and debuff enemies nearby
competences.description: Throw a flask that damages and reduces the weapon damage and move speed of enemies it hits.
ameliorations: -7s Cooldown and +2m Radius · Applies -30% Fire Rate

competences.resume: Gain a Barrier and move speed
competences.description: Gain a Barrier and bonus move speed.
ameliorations: +30% Debuff Resistance and improved Barrier scaling

competences.resume: Curse your target, rooting them if they don't escape
competences.description: Curse an enemy hero. If they don't move away from their initial position within the escape time, they will be damaged and immobilized.
ameliorations: Warden deals +20% more Bullet Damage to trapped Heroes for 5s
-14s Cooldown · Silences enemies until they escape or are immobilized

competences.resume: Emit pulses that steal health from enemies
competences.description: After charging for 2s, release pulses that damage enemies and heal you based on the damage done. · While channeling Last Stand you have greatly increased bullet and spirit resist.
ameliorations: +4s Duration · Unstoppable and +30% Resists while channeling

heros.style_de_jeu: Excelling at one-on-one combat, Wraith isolates targets, eliminating them with ruthless efficiency. Then teleporting away before anyone can retaliate.

competences.resume: Throw homing cards
competences.description: Deal weapon damage to summon cards of a random suit. Each card can be thrown, dealing damage and applying a different effect depending on its suit. Cards thrown fly towards the enemy or point under your crosshair. · · Alt-cast to throw first card
ameliorations: All suits are improved and higher chance for Jokers

competences.resume: Teleport to the targeted location
competences.description: Teleport to the targeted location.
ameliorations: 300 Barrier for 5s. Barrier scales with Spirit Power.

competences.resume: Boost your fire rate
competences.description: Temporarily boost your fire rate and deal bonus spirit damage
ameliorations: Unlimited Ammo and Increased Scaling on Spirit Damage Per Bullet

competences.resume: Lift an enemy, interrupting and silencing them
competences.description: Lift an enemy hero into the air and then slam them towards the target location.
ameliorations: +1.5s Debuff Duration and +6m Throw and Cast Range

heros.style_de_jeu: Yamato uses precise strikes to decimate her rivals. However, such damaging attacks often will leave her exposed, so she needs to make every shot count.

competences.resume: Charge up an attack, dealing high damage on a full charge
competences.description: Channel to increase damage over 1.4 seconds, then release a fully-charged sword strike. · Press Ability 1 or to trigger the strike early, dealing partial damage.
ameliorations: +8m Cast Range · +150.0 Damage and Increases Spirit Power scaling

competences.resume: Fly towards an enemy target
competences.description: Throw a grappling hook to reel yourself towards an enemy, dealingmelee damage and slowing the target when you arrive.
ameliorations: Alt-Cast to Grapple allies · +15m Cast Range · Gains 1 extra charge

competences.resume: Damage enemies nearby, healing on hit
competences.description: Slash enemies in front of you, damaging them and slowing their fire rate. If any enemy heroes are hit, you heal.
ameliorations: On Hero Hit : +6% Max Health Heal

competences.resume: Become invincible and more powerful
competences.description: Become infused with Yamato's shadow soul. After an initial invincible transformation your abilities are refreshed and are 60% faster. You gain immunity to negative status effects and have greatly increased bullet and spirit resist. · When you get a hero kill, you heal and the duration is extended.
